item.title: Perplexing Pubic Pain: How Clinicians Might Approach Assessing and Managing Pubic-Related Groin Pain in Athletes
item.description: Feld: Clinical Medicine Kategorie: Orthopedics Score: 13 Autoren: David F. Hanff, Solveig Thorarinsdottir, Adam Weir, Andrea B. Mosler, Willem M. P. Heijboer, Pim van Klij, Mathias Fabricius Nielsen Journal: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy Veröffentlicht: 2026-07-01 Abstract: SYNOPSIS: Pubic-related groin pain is one of the least common clinical entities of groin pain in athletes. However, it can cause persistent and long-standing pain. In this Viewpoint, we summarize the current state of knowledge regarding terminology, underlying pathology and diagnosis, and imaging findings for pubic-related groin pain. We share new perspectives on the clinical presentation, sex-related differences, examination, the role of diagnostic imaging, and how examination findings may direct management. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther 2026;56(7):376-381. Epub 12 February 2026. doi:10.2519/jospt.2026.13827 DOI: 10.2519/jospt.2026.13827 ISSN: 0190-6011 Tag der Erhebung (OOIR): 2026-07-30
